label: Mercado Ads (Mercado Libre Publicidad)
terms_note: Create a Mercado Libre application (developers.mercadolibre.com), OAuth 2.0 authorization code → access token (6 h) + refresh; Product Ads endpoints require the Api-Version header and the advertiser_id; per-site (MLA, MLB, MLM…). Rate limits per app. Free.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (Mercado Libre app; Bearer access token + Api-Version header)

official_mcp: Mercado Libre MCP Server (official, listed in the developers portal navigation)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Product Ads API + Display Ads API) Confidence: **high** — official docs read.
auth: 1. Create an app at developers.mercadolibre.com (redirect URI, scopes); user authorizes → `code` → `POST /oauth/token` → access token (6 h) + refresh token.
3. Send `Authorization: Bearer` + `Api-Version` on Product Ads calls.

clicks, prints, cost, cpc, acos, direct/indirect units, total_amount

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: App ID of your application (developers.mercadolibre.com > My applications); sent as client_id in the token request body.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Secret Key of the same application; sent as client_secret in the token request body.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token (TG-...) from a one-time authorization-code consent by the advertiser's ADMIN account (Product Ads enabled under Mi perfil > Publicidad) (valid 6 months). It is SINGLE-USE: every refresh returns a new access token (6 h) and a new refresh token, and only the last one issued is accepted. The runtime keeps a rotated refresh token in memory; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to also save it (<dir>/<platform>.json, mode 0600) so it is preferred over this variable on the next start. Without the state directory, a restart after the first refresh needs a fresh refresh token.

me.note: GET /users/me: the authorised Mercado Libre user {id, nickname, site_id}.

list_accounts.note: GET /advertising/advertisers?product_id=PADS (Api-Version: 1): Product Ads advertisers the user can access ({advertiser_id, site_id, advertiser_name, account_name}); the currency follows raw.site_id. A 404 'No permissions found for user_id' means Product Ads is not enabled for the user.

list_campaigns.note: GET /advertising/advertisers/{advertiser_id}/product_ads/campaigns (api-version: 2) with limit/offset and filters[status] (active or paused). `budget` is the campaign's daily budget in currency_id; raw carries strategy and acos_target.

get_report.note: Campaign search with metrics: GET /advertising/advertisers/{advertiser_id}/product_ads/campaigns?date_from&date_to&metrics=clicks,prints,ctr,cost,cpc,acos,units_quantity,total_amount (optionally filters[campaign_ids]); one row per campaign with totals for the range (first 50 campaigns). Dates can reach 90 days back; data refreshes daily at 10:00 GMT-3.

not_offered.update_budget: Mercado Libre's public Product Ads documentation is the read-only reference ("With the following Product Ads endpoints, you can monitor campaigns, ads, and metrics", https://developers.mercadolibre.com.ar/en_us/product-ads-us-read); no campaign update endpoint is documented publicly.
not_offered.pause_resume: No campaign status update endpoint is documented in the public Product Ads reference (https://developers.mercadolibre.com.ar/en_us/product-ads-us-read), which only covers reading campaigns, ads and metrics.
